meta.title: Add blockwise fp8 gemm kernel
meta.body_summary: Add CUDA kernels for blockwise FP8 GEMM, wire up FFI and Rust bindings, provide helper function and test, with conditional compilation for CUDA >= 8.0.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added CUDA FP8 GEMM kernel; coderabbitai bot identified critical compilation/ABI errors and performance issues, but no human maintainer action yet.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 380 changed lines (165 in ops.rs, 124 in CUDA kernel, plus build/FFI), this is a small-to-medium feature addition by absolute volume. As a performance feature PR it remains open, with bot review identifying correctness issues that must be addressed before merge.

review_details.concern_detail: coderabbitai bot found missing CustomOp3 import causing compilation failure, ABI mismatch between Rust FFI and dummy CUDA stubs (missing cudaStream_t), unconditional f32 cast leading to runtime failure for BF16/F16, and performance concerns (global memory dot-product).
review_details.performance_claim: Add blockwise FP8 GEMM kernel for efficient mixed-precision matrix multiplication.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding a CUDA kernel with FFI across Rust and C/CUDA requires precise ABI alignment and conditional compilation; the agent introduced cross-language correctness issues that must be resolved.

detection_detail.code_reading: coderabbitai bot performed static analysis on the diff, identifying compilation errors, ABI mismatches, and performance constructs.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Author's provided test command fails due to dependency issues; no successful execution evidence.

core_change_summary.description: Added CUDA kernel for blockwise FP8 GEMM in blockwise_fp8_gemm.cu, dummy stub in blockwise_fp8_gemm_dummy.cu, updated build.rs for conditional compilation based on CUDA capability, added FFI declarations in ffi.rs, and implemented Fp8BlockwiseGemm custom op in ops.rs with validation and kernel invocation.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Build system and dummy stubs ensure conditional compilation for CUDA capability; no observability or test files were added.
change_trajectory: Single commit adding all files: kernel, dummy, build script changes, FFI declarations, and Rust operator implementation with test.

review_signals.summary: Missing CustomOp3 import breaks compilation; cargo check fails with use of undeclared type.
HAVE_BLOCKWISE_GEMM_KERNELS constant is rewritten by build script, risking rebuild loops; suggest generating into OUT_DIR.
Rust FFI signatures include CUstream parameter; ensure C/CUDA definitions match exactly to avoid ABI mismatch.
Dummy CUDA functions omit cudaStream_t parameter, causing call-stack corruption if invoked.
Unconditional as_cuda_slice::<f32>() before dtype check causes runtime failure for BF16/F16 inputs.
Contiguity check does not verify start_offset==0, risking incorrect device pointer offsets.
Posted walkthrough summary of changes including sequence diagram and file overview.
Posted code metrics report showing lines by language.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by EricLBuehler with single commit adding blockwise FP8 GEMM.
coderabbitai bot immediately posted walkthrough and detailed review with 5 actionable comments, highlighting compilation errors, ABI mismatches, and performance concerns.
No human maintainer response yet; PR remains open.
